title: Wikipedia geometry item 7: Fujita conjecture regarding the line bundle $K_{M} \otimes L^{\otimes m}$ constructed from a po…
exact_target: Let $M$ be a smooth projective complex variety of dimension $n$, $L$ an ample line bundle, and $K_M$ the canonical line bundle. Must $K_M\otimes L^{\otimes m}$ be globally generated for $m\geq n+1$ and very ample for $m\geq n+2$?
